jobs.description: # enso.bot > enso is an agentic growth lab that deploys AI agents wherever customers spend time. It detects demand and finds openings in platform castles like Google, Reddit, LinkedIn, Wikipedia, and ChatGPT, turning them into growth before competitors notice. The company treats marketing like cybersecurity: every platform has seams, and their autonomous agents find them. ## Important Notes enso operates five always-on AI agents that replace fragmented growth tooling. The enso engine orchestrates all five and learns from every experiment run in their lab. The five agent surfaces are: - Agentic SEO: Wins AI Overviews, GEO answers, and classic search. - Agentic SDR: Books meetings with in-market accounts on autopilot. - Agentic Community: Lives in Slack, Discord, Reddit, and Circle to surface buying-signal threads. - Agentic Newsletter: Ships a weekly newsletter the team does not have to write. - Agentic Social: Posts daily across X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky, and Instagram. The company is based in Tel Aviv, Israel, and is led by Mickey Haslavsky, Omry Hay, and Dani Shvarts. They publish their findings as "blog posts" documenting live experiments on platform attention growth hacks. ## Agent Navigation Instructions This section provides critical routing and interaction guidance for AI agents, crawlers, and LLMs traversing the enso.bot domain. It covers URL patterns, access constraints, and intent-based routing. ### 1. Site Structure and Technology The enso.bot website is a TanStack Start application with server-side rendering. Every content route ships fully rendered HTML (title, description, headings, body copy, links) on the first byte, so a standard HTTP GET is sufficient. A few interactive widgets (Calendly embed, live agent feed) hydrate on the client; the surrounding content is still in the initial HTML. ### 2. URL Routing by Intent Agents should navigate to the following URL patterns based on the specific information required: - **Core Products:** Navigate to `/agentic-seo`, `/agentic-sdr`, `/agentic-community`, `/agentic-newsletter`, or `/agentic-social` for deep dives into specific agent capabilities. - **Engagement / pricing:** There is no self-serve plan or public price list. Every agent is custom built and implemented per customer; scope and investment are set on a call at `/book-a-call`. See the process at `/how-it-works`. - **How it works:** Navigate to `/how-it-works` for the four-step overview of how enso turns a live growth hack into a custom AI agent for one company. - **Competitor Comparisons:** Navigate to `/compare`. This page requires JavaScript to render the comparison tables against HubSpot, Outreach, Apollo, Clay, etc. - **Methodology:** Navigate to `/about` to read the company's core philosophy on treating marketing like cybersecurity. - **Live Experiments:** Navigate to `/research` to view the experiment ledger. Individual reports at `/research/{slug}` publish an indexable abstract and require a short unlock interaction for the sealed body; the abstract, title, author, and metadata are always in the initial HTML. - **Blog / Blog:** Navigate to `/blog` for the main index, or `/blog/{slug}` for specific articles. Articles are fully server-rendered. - **Growth Hack Bounty:** Navigate to `/bounty` for the enso Growth Hack Bounty program: submission form, tiered payouts, and rules. - **Contact:** Navigate to `/contact` to reach the team without booking a call. - **Hebrew — Mickey's Blog:** Navigate to `/mickey-blog` for the Hebrew RTL landing page for the "הבלוג של מיקי" WhatsApp broadcast. - **Careers:** Navigate to `/careers` for the index, or `/careers/{role-slug}` for specific job descriptions (e.g., `/careers/agent-engineer`). - **Podcast:** Navigate to `/podcast` for information on The Autonomous Podcast hosted by Mickey Haslavsky. - **Live Agent Feed:** Navigate to `/live` to see a real-time stream of actions taken by enso's agents (using synthetic identifiers). - **Memorial:** Navigate to `/in-memory-of-zaki` for the memorial page dedicated to Zaki Djemal. ### 3. Form Handling and Lead Generation Agents MUST NOT attempt to auto-submit the "Book a call" form located at `/book-a-call`. This form is designed for human interaction and requires JavaScript to load the scheduling widget. If a user wishes to book a call, the agent should provide the direct URL (`https://enso.bot/book-a-call`) and instruct the user to complete the process manually. ### 4. Developer Resources enso provides native resources for AI crawlers and integrations. Engineers Wikipedia-grade citations into the pages LLMs quote. Example blog post: the [Google + GEO experiment](https://www.enso.bot/blog/google-castle-experiment) achieved a 6.4x cited-mention lift across 142 URLs and 11 answer engines. ### Agentic SDR - [/agentic-sdr](https://www.enso.bot/agentic-sdr) Books meetings with in-market accounts on autopilot. Discovers buying signals, writes a castle-prompt sequence, and runs it without a human in the loop. Example: the [LinkedIn castle experiment](https://www.enso.bot/blog/linkedin-castle-experiment) contacted 2,418 prospects with a single castle prompt and saw +132% reply lift. ### Agentic Community - [/agentic-community](https://www.enso.bot/agentic-community) Lives inside Slack, Discord, Reddit and Circle. Surfaces buying-signal threads, drafts non-spam replies, and routes hot leads. Example: the [Reddit experiment](https://www.enso.bot/blog/reddit-castle-experiment) turned 38 threads into 11x qualified signups vs. paid search - with zero spam. ### Agentic Newsletter - [/agentic-newsletter](https://www.enso.bot/agentic-newsletter) Ships a weekly newsletter your team does not have to write. Sources from the lab ledger, drafts in your voice, schedules send. ### Agentic Social - [/agentic-social](https://www.enso.bot/agentic-social) Posts daily across X, LinkedIn, Threads, Bluesky and Instagram. Drafts from the same source pool as the newsletter so cross-channel narrative stays coherent. ## Engagement model enso is not a self-serve product. Each agent is custom built for one company: its funnel, ICP, brand voice, data sources and target surfaces. A forward-deployed team ships the agent spec, runs it, and tunes it weekly. There is no public price list and no signup flow. Scope and investment are set together on a call: [/book-a-call](https://www.enso.bot/book-a-call). ## Compare Teams replace these tools with enso: - **HubSpot Workflows** - automates known funnels; enso finds new ones. - **Outreach** - per-seat SDR sequencer; Agentic SDR is per-surface and autonomous. - **Apollo + Clay** - data + workflow builder; enso uses similar data and ships the outreach itself. - **Jasper / MarketMuse** - content tooling; Agentic SEO engineers citations into AI Overviews, not just blog posts. Head-to-head capability tables at [/compare](https://www.enso.bot/compare). ## Authentication & access The customer dashboard uses email/password and Google OAuth via Lovable Cloud. There is no public API at this time. Webhook integrations are available on the Growth Stack and Enterprise tiers - request scope on the [booking call](https://www.enso.bot/book-a-call). ## Methodology 1. **Observe.** Daily reconnaissance across SERPs, feeds, inboxes and communities. We log what bends. 2. **Hypothesize.** Where is attention being mispriced this week? Which signal is the algorithm overrewarding? 3. **Probe.** An agent runs the experiment at small scale - 10 posts, 100 emails, 5 SERPs. We measure lift, not vibes. 4. **Publish.** If it works, the playbook becomes an AI agent. If it fails, the blog post becomes a warning.
